clips.title: The story
paras: At the Temple of the Moon, Sathrah's Sacrifice offers Lady Sathrah's spirit a chance at peace. Her silvery spinnerets come from the mighty spider who dwells in Teldrassil.

Lady Sathrah was a venerable creature of Teldrassil, until creeping madness and corruption spread through the great tree's boughs and took hold of her. The Sisterhood of Elune asks you to bring back her silvery spinnerets as a consecrated offering, not a trophy. At the fountain in the Temple of the Moon, the remains are bathed in holy water. The rite washes away the taint that poisoned Sathrah's mind and frees her troubled soul. Her spirit then appears peacefully within the sanctuary, with the promise of rebirth under Elune's grace.
